craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra-adbhuta of tended glory through impurity — the Lord in wandering (v14 absent in data too: edition numbering gap, not a defect; L4 follows the L3 set). Loosed-away goddess; grace-deemed + veiling-named double close. Rejected: (a) grace→mercy → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: LOOSED-a-WAY … VEIL-ing-NAMED.

lines: Loosed away, withdrawn goddess — in knowing-oneness, grace deemed;

reads_against.argmap: What grace in unity? → Withdrawn goddess graces unity; concealment named of manifesting.
c1_essence: Tended means; Lord tends; release-glory proceeds.
God's five, self's five; delusion the difference.
Expansion sung capable; contraction called wanderer.
Withdrawn grace in oneness; manifesting named veiling.
